profile.headline: Software Engineer at Abercrombie & Fitch
profile.summary: Hard working and driven developer with a passion for learning and rich coding experience in both professional and personal settings. Skilled in full stack development, CI/CD, cloud computing, and product design.

positions.title: Director of Technology
positions.description:
Leading the effort to publish the non-profit's 8,000+ instances of open-source court data through explorable dashboards by:
• Building a web-application in React with Next.js, utilizing the Google Sheets and Google Drive APIs.
• Leading discussions within the team to decide on the features and direction of the application.
• Conducting user interviews to ensure the best user-experience is provided.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Data Visualization · User Experience (UX) · Google API

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contribute in large part to the ongoing modernization of our Customer Account Management
application from Java Spring to Angular by performing development on the front-end, backend,
and test suite through all stages of the project, planning and leading releases, contributing to both code design and UI design, and assisting team members to better understand the project.
• Assume the roll of interim tech lead in the absence of our lead or when assistance is needed. This
includes scheduling and leading releases, attending estimation sessions, acting as the primary signoff
for code reviews, overseeing ongoing efforts within the team, and solving problems that arise
within my own or collaborating teams.
• Lead small projects by working closely with our product owner to understand business
requirements, analyzing our codebase to plan out the best strategy to implement, writing technical
requirements in Jira cards, and working with developers and testers to answer questions and ensure
everything is carried out correctly.
• Collaborate with others through mentoring developers, on-boarding new team members,
working on projects that span across multiple teams, leading knowledge transfers within my own
and other teams, and engaging in application design sessions.

positions.title: Miami University Fitness Center, Programming Intern
positions.description: Internship with Miami University’s Recreational Sports Center to develop a system that monitors the usage patterns of the thousands of weekly fitness center visitors. The program parses three Google Sheets containing over 35,000 cells of raw data, meaningfully inserts the data into a database, and grants front-end access in the form of charts. This was programmed in Python using the Django web-framework with a PostgreSQL database and is deployed through the Heroku cloud platform.

positions.title: Fitness Center Student Manager
positions.description: Supervise over 60 employees to maintain the cleanliness of the facility and the well-being of the patrons. Participate in a team environment with other student managers to creatively solve problems and undertake projects that better the facility. Engage in planning and communication by leading in-services and conducting interviews for new hires.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Research project funded by the National Science Foundation to improve safety of long haul truck drivers. Responsibilities include transforming data into useful formats, comparing the performance of systems for storing and querying the data, and making the data available for others.

positions.title: Undergraduate Assistant, Introduction to Media and Culture
positions.description: Lead 20 teaching sessions to present class material and facilitate discussion between 8-12 students. Communicate with students and the course professor regularly to provide information and resolve conflicts.

positions.title: Front Desk Clerk
positions.description: Interact with customers regularly to provide exceptional customer service and assist in administrative duties.

volunteerExperiences.description: Seasonally provide instruction and assistance for youth sports like football, tee-ball, soccer, and basketball. Help includes teaching children sports specific skills, setting up and tearing down game fields, and handling any issues that may arise.
